sub_answers.text: He excelled as an interior rebounder and defensive presence, earning ACC Defensive Player of the Year honors and repeatedly leading Wake Forest in rebounds in key games [d30156859s2p0]. He produced strong low-post scoring and physical interior play, exemplified by 12 points and 22 rebounds in the Sweet 16 and 14 points, 16 rebounds and six assists in the Elite Eight [d30156859s2p0]. He acted as the team’s on-court leader, earning multiple ACC Player of the Year awards and national player of the year honors for his all-around impact [d30156859s2p0].

sub_answers.text: Scouts and writers repeatedly labeled him an elite perimeter defender and versatile on-ball stopper while noting limitations offensively when he entered the league, particularly limited outside shooting and playmaking early in his career [d31163849s20p0] [d31163849s3p0]. Analysts noted that he was known more for defense and rebounding than for his offensive capabilities upon arrival, with outside shooting singled out as a concern [d31163849s3p0]. His playmaking was cited as a weakness through his first eight seasons, with averages never exceeding 3.5 assists per game until 2019–20 [d31163849s20p0].
